<ul class="mb-3 list-disc pl-5 last:mb-0 [&_ul]:list-[circle]">
<li class="mb-1"><strong class="font-medium">Seats:</strong> You pay per teammate based on your plan (Essential, Advanced, Expert)</li>

</ul>
<p class="mb-3 last:mb-0">All plans include access to Intercom and Fin AI Agent. <p class="mb-3 last:mb-0">An outcome is counted when:</p>
<ul class="mb-3 list-disc pl-5 last:mb-0 [&_ul]:list-[circle]">
<li class="mb-1">A customer confirms their issue is resolved, or</li>
<li class="mb-1">They don’t ask for more help after Fin responds, or</li>

We’re seeing a 50% resolution rate with Fin, which is pretty amazing! ” Ben Peak Director, Technical Support at Robin “ Since launching Fin AI Agent, our resolution time has gone from five days and five hours to four hours and 37 minutes, a 96% decrease. ” Constantina Samara VP of Customer Support at Synthesia FAQs How does Intercom pricing work? Intercom pricing has two components: Seats: You pay per teammate based on your plan (Essential, Advanced, Expert) Usage: You pay for what you use (e.g. Fin outcomes, messaging channels) All plans include access to Intercom and Fin AI Agent. Want a tailored estimate? Use the pricing calculator . How is Fin AI Agent priced? Fin is priced at $0.99 per outcome . An outcome is counted when: A customer confirms their issue is resolved, or They don’t ask for more help after Fin responds, or Fin completes a workflow (Procedure), including handoffs You’re only charged once per conversation, even if multiple questions are answered. Can I use Fin with my existing helpdesk? Yes. Fin can be used with tools like Salesforce and others. Pricing: $0.99 per outcome Minimum monthly commitment applies (e.g. 50 outcomes) No seat costs No setup, integration, or platform fees What plans does Intercom offer? Intercom offers three plans: Essential Advanced Expert Your plan determines: Seat price Feature access Included capabilities (e.g. Lite seats on higher tiers) What is a seat (Full vs Lite)? Full seat: Paid. Required for teammates who interact with customers and use core features. Lite seat: Free (on Advanced/Expert). Limited access for internal collaboration. Only Full seats can send messages or fully use features like outbound content. Are there additional usage charges? Yes. Beyond seats, pricing is usage-based for certain features: Fin AI Agent: $0.99 per outcome WhatsApp: Charged per conversation (varies by volume/direction) SMS: Charged per message (varies by region) Email campaigns: Charged per bulk email sent Phone: Usage-based (varies) Inbound support (e.g. responding to customer emails) is included. What is Proactive Support Plus? An optional add-on for outbound engagement. $99/month includes 500 messages Covers: Product Tours, Surveys, In-app messages, Mobile Push, Carousels Additional messages are charged per unit How much is Copilot? Copilot is an optional add-on at $29 per agent/month billed annually , or $35 per agent/month billed monthly, for unlimited usage. Copilot is a personal AI assistant in the Inbox that helps your team resolve conversations faster. Every agent also gets 10 Copilot and 10 AI Auto-translation conversations free each month. What is the Pro add-on? Pro is an optional add-on at $99/month , which includes analysis of 1,000 conversations/month and 2,000 credits per month. Pro is a set of advanced AI features for managing and improving your support operation. It includes Operator, an agent for customer operations, plus features that help you analyze performance, monitor quality, identify trends, and continuously improve Fin. Credits are the unit used to measure and charge for Operator usage. Every Pro workspace receives monthly credits, and the number of credits included scales with conversation volume. If you use more credits than what’s included in Pro, you can buy additional credits at $0.01 per credit. Simple actions use fewer credits, while more complex work, like analyzing large sets of conversations, building automation, or testing changes, uses more. You can track usage, set alerts, and use hard limits to control spend. Do I need a contract? No. Monthly or annual self-serve plans are available (Essential, Advanced) Contracts are optional and required for: Enterprise needs Premier Support / onboarding Custom terms What’s the minimum to get started? 1 Full seat minimum No required platform fees beyond that Usage (e.g. Fin, messaging) is pay-as-you-go This makes it easy to start small and scale. Is there a free trial? Yes. 14-day free trial No credit card required Includes all features, Fin, and add-ons You only pay once you choose a plan and add payment details. How do I change my plan or seats? You can: Upgrade/downgrade plans Add/remove seats Add or remove add-ons Handled directly in your workspace (or via Sales if under contract). Downgrades typically take effect at renewal. Are there discounts available? Yes. Yes. Beyond seats, pricing is usage-based for certain features:

Fin AI Agent: $0.99 per outcome
WhatsApp: Charged per conversation (varies by volume/direction)
SMS: Charged per message (varies by region)
Email campaigns: Charged per bulk email sent
Phone: Usage-based (varies)

Inbound support (e.g. responding to customer emails) is included.

An optional add-on for outbound engagement.

$99/month includes 500 messages
Covers: Product Tours, Surveys, In-app messages, Mobile Push, Carousels
Additional messages are charged per unit

Copilot is an optional add-on at $29 per agent/month billed annually, or $35 per agent/month billed monthly, for unlimited usage.

Copilot is a personal AI assistant in the Inbox that helps your team resolve conversations faster. Every agent also gets 10 Copilot and 10 AI Auto-translation conversations free each month.

Pro is an optional add-on at $99/month, which includes analysis of 1,000 conversations/month and 2,000 credits per month.

Pro is a set of advanced AI features for managing and improving your support operation. It includes Operator, an agent for customer operations, plus features that help you analyze performance, monitor quality, identify trends, and continuously improve Fin.

Credits are the unit used to measure and charge for Operator usage. Every Pro workspace receives monthly credits, and the number of credits included scales with conversation volume. If you use more credits than what’s included in Pro, you can buy additional credits at $0.01 per credit. Simple actions use fewer credits, while more complex work, like analyzing large sets of conversations, building automation, or testing changes, uses more. You can track usage, set alerts, and use hard limits to control spend.

No.

Monthly or annual self-serve plans are available (Essential, Advanced)

https://fin.ai/about.visible_text: Fin is the Customer Agent company delivering perfect customer experiences Log in Contact sales Start free trial View demo Contact sales Intercom → Product AI Technology Integrations Customers Resources Pricing Log in Contact sales Start free trial View demo Intercom → The only helpdesk designed for the AI Agent era Intercom has every feature your team needs to resolve queries faster, deliver personalized service, engage proactively, and continuously improve your customer experience. Fin is defining the AI era of customer experience Fin is defining the AI era of customer experience Fin is the Customer Agent company delivering perfect customer experiences – from support to sales to commerce. 30,000 + companies use our products. Fin resolves over 2 million conversations weekly, is doubling growth year on year, and has surpassed $400M in annual recurring revenue. Founded as Intercom in 2011, we revolutionized modern customer communication. When it became clear AI would fundamentally reshape the industry, we reinvented the company – rebuilding our product, infrastructure, and team around AI. Still founder-led, we're one of the largest and fastest-growing private software companies in the world, with more than 1,400 people across six global offices. We’re only getting started. Now with Salesforce, we can bring Fin into more businesses, making perfect customer experiences possible for millions more people. Our vision for the future of customer experience We believe businesses are best served by a single agent with full context across the entire customer journey, delivering experiences that were never before possible. Fin for Service delivers perfect customer service Fin for Sales handles inbound sales end-to-end Fin for Ecommerce handles the entire shopping journey Another new role, coming soon Our journey 2026 The Customer Agent Transitions to in-house, purpose-built AI model, Apex 1.0. Fin evolves from Customer Service Agent to Customer Agent. Expanding the vision to the entire customer journey. The company is renamed from Intercom to Fin. 2025 AI and R&D Expansion Growing our AI group to 60 AI researchers. Expanding our R&D team. Further expansion in Europe with a new Berlin office. 2024 A Leader in AI Fin resolves 1M+ tickets weekly and is the leader in AI-powered customer service. 2023 Fin Launches Fin AI Agent goes live. Industry-leading resolution rates from day one. The future of customer service arrives. 2022 AI Transformation Eoghan returns as CEO. Fin commits $100M+ to AI development. A new chapter begins. 2020 $150M Revenue Navigating global challenges. Continuing to grow. Laying groundwork for what's next. 2018 Unicorn Status $1.3B valuation. Series D complete. One of Europe's most valuable startups. 2016 $50M ARR One of the fastest companies ever to reach $50M in annual recurring revenue. A new category is forming. 2013 First Major Funding Series A raised. San Francisco office opens. The vision begins to scale. 2011 The Beginning Four co-founders—Eoghan McCabe, Des Traynor, Ciaran Lee, and David Barrett—start Fin with a simple belief: internet business should feel personal. Our offices San Francisco 55 2nd Street, 4th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94105 View roles London 9th Floor, The Warehouse, 211 Old St, London EC1V 9NR View roles Chicago 1330 W. Fulton Market, Suite 750, Chicago, IL 60607 View roles Dublin 124 St Stephen's Green, Dublin 2, D02 C628 View roles Sydney 1st Floor, 285A Crown St Surry Hills NSW 2010 View roles Berlin Floor 7, Zimmerstrasse 78, 10117 Berlin View roles Leadership Eoghan McCabe CEO and Chairman of the Board Eoghan built his first internet business in 2000 and went on to found Contrast, a software development company that built products for startups and enterprises alike. Read full bio Des Traynor Chief Strategy Officer & Co-founder Des Traynor is Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer of Fin, sitting on the company's Board of Directors. He has led many teams within Fin - including Product, Marketing, Customer Support, and Content - and today oversees Fin's R&D team in the Dublin and London offices. Read full bio Paul Adams Chief Product Officer Paul Adams is Fin's Chief Product Officer, leading the Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Research teams. He advised Fin before joining, later becoming a member of what was then only a 14-person company. Read full bio Fergal Reid Chief AI Officer Fergal specializes in navigating the space between ‘what to build’ and ‘how to build it’ for Data and ML products. With a PhD in machine learning, he has a track record of building world-class engineering and product teams. Read full bio Archana Agrawal President Archana Agrawal is President at Fin, leading go-to-market strategy and the Sales, Marketing, Success and Solutions, and Support teams. Read full bio Darragh Curran Chief Technology Officer Darragh Curran is the Chief Technology Officer at Fin, leading Product Engineering, Growth Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and IT teams. He has scaled and evolved engineering teams and culture at Fin since 2012. Read full bio Ciaran Lee Chief Engineer & Co-founder Ciaran Lee is Chief Engineer and Co-founder at Fin. He served as Chief Technology Officer for 10 years before taking a break for family and angel investing. He then returned to focus on strategic technology projects. Read full bio Jordan Neill Chief Operating Officer Jordan is a homegrown Fin leader who rose through the engineering organisation to Senior Vice President of Engineering before becoming Chief Operating Officer. He holds a Computer Science degree from Trinity College Dublin. Read full bio Dan Griggs Chief Financial Officer Dan Griggs is the Chief Financial Officer of Fin, leading Financial Planning & Analysis, and Accounting. Read full bio Lauren Cullen SVP, People Lauren Cullen is Senior Vice President of People at Fin. She directs People Operations, Total Rewards, People Programs, Business Partners, Recruitment, and Real Estate and Workplace Management. Read full bio Our board of directors Eoghan McCabe Eoghan built his first internet business in 2000 and went on to found Contrast, a software development company that built products for startups and enterprises alike. Read full bio Des Traynor Des Traynor is Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer of Fin, sitting on the company's Board of Directors. He has led many teams within Fin - including Product, Marketing, Customer Support, and Content - and today oversees Fin's R&D team in the Dublin and London offices. Read full bio Cameron Deatsch Cameron was the Chief Revenue Officer at Atlassian from 2020 to 2023, where he ran the marketing, sales, and support organizations. Read full bio Talia Goldberg Talia Goldberg is a partner in Bessemer's San Francisco office and invests across software and consumer companies. She supports teams that leverage AI to progress the way we live and work. Read full bio Eileen Naughton Eileen Naughton serves as an Intercom advisor and board member. She retired from Google in June 2021 as Chief People Officer and a member of Google's executive leadership team. Read full bio Abhijeet Dwivedi Abhijeet is part of OpenAI where he works on special projects. Previously he was co-founder and CEO of ZeroDown and Central, as well as COO and CSO at Zenefits. Read full bio Bobby Pinero Bobby Pinero is the CEO and Co-Founder of Equals. Bobby was previously the Senior Director of Finance & Analytics at Fin from October 2013 to March 2021. jsonld_parsed.name: About Fin (formerly Intercom)
jsonld_parsed.description: About Fin (formerly Intercom). Fin is the Customer Agent company delivering perfect customer experiences from support to sales to commerce.

jsonld_parsed.caption: The #1 AI Agent for all your customer service

jsonld_parsed.name: Fin
jsonld_parsed.description: One AI Customer Agent for Sales, Service, Support and Ecommerce. Featuring Fin AI Agent and Intercom Helpdesk.

jsonld_parsed.name: Fin
jsonld_parsed.description: Fin is the Customer Agent company delivering perfect customer experiences from support to sales to commerce.

jsonld_parsed.name: Eoghan McCabe
jsonld_parsed.jobTitle: CEO and Chairman of the Board
jsonld_parsed.description: Eoghan built his first internet business in 2000 and went on to found Contrast, a software development company that built products for startups and enterprises alike.

jsonld_parsed.name: Des Traynor
jsonld_parsed.description: Des Traynor is Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer of Fin, sitting on the company's Board of Directors. He has led many teams within Fin, including Product, Marketing, Customer Support, and Content, and today oversees Fin's R&D team in the Dublin and London offices.

jsonld_parsed.name: Paul Adams
jsonld_parsed.description: Paul Adams is Fin's Chief Product Officer, leading the Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Research teams. He advised Fin before joining, later becoming a member of what was then only a 14-person company.

jsonld_parsed.name: Fergal Reid
jsonld_parsed.description: Fergal specializes in navigating the space between what to build and how to build it for Data and ML products. With a PhD in machine learning, he has a track record of building world-class engineering and product teams.

jsonld_parsed.name: Archana Agrawal
jsonld_parsed.description: Archana Agrawal is President at Fin, leading go-to-market strategy and the Sales, Marketing, Success and Solutions, and Support teams.

jsonld_parsed.name: Darragh Curran
jsonld_parsed.description: Darragh Curran is the Chief Technology Officer at Fin, leading Product Engineering, Growth Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and IT teams. He has scaled and evolved engineering teams and culture at Fin since 2012.

jsonld_parsed.name: Ciaran Lee
jsonld_parsed.description: Ciaran Lee is Chief Engineer and Co-founder at Fin. He served as Chief Technology Officer for 10 years before taking a break for family and angel investing. He then returned to focus on strategic technology projects.

jsonld_parsed.name: Jordan Neill
jsonld_parsed.description: Jordan is a homegrown Fin leader who rose through the engineering organisation to Senior Vice President of Engineering before becoming Chief Operating Officer. He holds a Computer Science degree from Trinity College Dublin.

jsonld_parsed.name: Dan Griggs
jsonld_parsed.description: Dan Griggs is the Chief Financial Officer of Fin, leading Financial Planning & Analysis and Accounting.

jsonld_parsed.name: Lauren Cullen
jsonld_parsed.description: Lauren Cullen is Senior Vice President of People at Fin. She directs People Operations, Total Rewards, People Programs, Business Partners, Recruitment, and Real Estate and Workplace Management.

jsonld_parsed.name: Cameron Deatsch
jsonld_parsed.description: Cameron was the Chief Revenue Officer at Atlassian from 2020 to 2023, where he ran the marketing, sales, and support organizations.

jsonld_parsed.name: Abhijeet Dwivedi
jsonld_parsed.description: Abhijeet is part of OpenAI where he works on special projects. Previously he was co-founder and CEO of ZeroDown and Central, as well as COO and CSO at Zenefits.

jsonld_parsed.name: Talia Goldberg
jsonld_parsed.description: Talia Goldberg is a partner in Bessemer's San Francisco office and invests across software and consumer companies. She supports teams that leverage AI to progress the way we live and work.

jsonld_parsed.name: Eileen Naughton
jsonld_parsed.description: Eileen Naughton serves as a Fin advisor and board member. She retired from Google in June 2021 as Chief People Officer and a member of Google's executive leadership team.

jsonld_parsed.name: Bobby Pinero
jsonld_parsed.description: Bobby Pinero is the CEO and Co-Founder of Equals. Bobby was previously the Senior Director of Finance & Analytics at Fin from October 2013 to March 2021.
